Class DungeonApplication.GameServiceImpl

Enclosing class:

public static class DungeonApplication.GameServiceImpl extends GameServiceGrpc.GameServiceImplBase
Implementation of the GameService gRPC service. Manages client connections and streams for game command requests and responses. Utilizes a lobby facade for game logic operations.
